latin: Melius potest saluare textus Aristotelis qui dicit omnem animam esse immortalem, quam qui dicit omnem animam esse mortalem.
latin_note: 1486 reads 'salvari', corrected by the Emendationes errorum to 'salvare'; 1487 leaves the text unemended.
translation: Whoever maintains that every soul is immortal does more justice to Aristotle's text than whoever maintains that every soul is mortal.
